- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in early forecast periods (first 5–10 days of forecast horizon).
- Forecasts tend to peak too early after sharp price spikes, then overshoot and fail to correct downward.
- Model exhibits mean reversion bias: overestimates after strong upward moves, underestimates after strong downward moves.
- Forecast horizon 1–3 days shows significant lag; model reacts too slowly to recent price changes.
- Model underestimates volatility in late forecast periods (last 5–10 days), leading to underprediction of sharp drops or spikes.
- Forecasts are overly smooth; fail to capture sudden, non-linear price shifts (e.g., 3–5 day spikes followed by sharp drops).
- Model tends to ignore recent low prices in the history window, leading to persistent overestimation when true prices dip.
